gloss: to close, to set a deadline

definitions.gloss: to close tightly, to shut completely
definitions.explanation: To close doors, windows, etc. completely to seal off a space.

definitions.gloss: to set a deadline, to close (applications)
definitions.explanation: To establish a final date for accepting applications, submissions, etc.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}を{締|し}め{切|き}って{冷房|れいぼう}をつけた。
examples.english: I closed all the windows and turned on the AC.

examples.japanese: {応募|おうぼ}は{明日|あした}{締|し}め{切|き}ります。
{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.notes: {締|し}め{切|き}り is the noun form

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {締|し}める (to close) + {切|き}る (to cut/complete). The suffix 切る adds the meaning of doing something completely.

RELATED NOUN:
{締|し}め{切|き}り: deadline
